messages:
miriam: quick follow-up to the lookahead RFC — we're seeing flaky duplicate work when SDKs do lookahead page fetches + transport retries. repro: python client lookahead fetches next page, transport hiccup retries, server returns same page -> app sees duplicated items.
jon: ouch. is this because lookahead doesn't use any idempotency token so retries re-run the same cursor fetch?
deepak: yep. two separate layers: transport-level automatic retries and iterator-level lookahead. they conflict. we need a coordination surface.
alexa: options: (1) make lookahead opt-out of transport retries (fire-and-forget) and dedupe in iterator; (2) attach a stable resume_token/idempotency header so transport retries are safe; (3) expose a transport hint from iterator so transport can avoid auto-retry for lookahead.
miriam: tradeoffs?
jon: (1) simplest server side but pushes complexity into SDKs, dedupe in memory is painful for big streams. (2) nice correctness but requires server contract change to honor client idempotency tokens for cursor reads. (3) incremental: add a hint header like PREFETCH so transport treats it differently.
deepak: for (2) resume_token must be stable and represent a read-only cursor. problems appear if server treats fetch as having side effects (ack, lease renew). we should mark fetches as read-only in the contract.
alexa: ergonomics across languages: python/ts keep async iterator ergonomic with a prefetch/lookahead flag; go via context option. avoid exposing raw idempotency tokens to app devs.
pat: API mockups:
Python:
```
async for item in client.list_items(lookahead=True):
    ...
```
TS:
```
for await (const it of client.listItems({ lookahead: true })) { }
```
Go:
```
it := client.ListItems(ctx, opts)
for it.Next() { v := it.Value() }
```
ctx option toggles lookahead behavior.
jon: backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged. opt-in to new header for servers to apply idempotent semantics. servers ignore unknown headers.
miriam: observability: add metrics `iterator.lookahead.duplicates` and `lookahead.retry_suppressed` and an event log when dedupe/duplicates exceed threshold.
deepak: testing: interop test across python/ts/go where transport injects transient 500 on lookahead call; assert no duplicates and no missing items. include flakey latency tests.
alexa: implementation tasks: 1) transport hint header + transport behavior (suppress auto-retry for lookahead) 2) iterator session id + idempotency key generation 3) server accepts/ignores headers; when header present treat fetch-by-cursor as idempotent 4) SDK opt-in flag, docs, and migration guide 5) metrics and alerting.
jon: note: suppressing retry increases visible prefetch latency on failure; acceptable since lookahead is optional optimization. main goal is correctness.
ci-bot: deploy-note: server change behind feature-flag; SDKs ship opt-in disabled until server stable.
miriam: naming: `X-Redwood-Lookahead` + `X-Redwood-Idempotency` look good? keeps scope.
deepak: +1. optionally `X-Redwood-Lookahead-Seq` for sequence numbers for dedupe assistance.
alexa: i'll draft a short RFC PR with examples for py/ts/go and test plan. i'll own SDK changes. jon/deepak handle server/transport. i'll open PR this afternoon. :thumbsup:
